title: Proper/open lambda completion transport
statement: For every finite word of length at most three in the admissible domain, reduction of its recursive completion map followed by its recursive r-map equals the corresponding ordinary coefficient map.

source.place: Proper/open lambda coefficient-square expansion, split-off intermediate statement.

proof.text: Induct on the finite word. Input and unit cases reduce by reflexivity and functor identity laws.
Apply the corresponding strict constructor equation for tensor, pull, push, or open.

proof_origin.place: Structural induction reduced to strict constructor equations.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing public declaration combines the specified finite-word maps; the intermediate statement is project-specific.

from.place: Split-off intermediate for its ordinary/clopen proof route.

lean.statement:
theorem properOpenLambdaCompletionTransport
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} (Cf : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic Cf.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic Cf.l) E] (o : Operations Cf.l E)
    {S : Type s} (W : S → Scheme.{u})
    {I : Type i} (location : I → S)
    {a : S} (B : Word W location a) (hB : B.length ≤ 3)
    (K : ∀ k : I, DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource Cf.l E (W (location k))))
    (lo hi torLo torHi : ℤ)
    (hInputs : ∀ k : I, Admissible Cf.l E
      (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus Cf.l E (W (location k))) (K k)
      lo hi torLo torHi)
    (hBAdmissible : Word.admissible Cf.l E W location o K lo hi torLo torHi B) :
    (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus Cf.l E (W a)).reduction.map
        (B.completionMap Cf.l E W location o K) ≫
      B.r Cf.l E W location o K =
      properOpenOrdinaryR Cf.l E location o K B
